resolvedSprint.name: Budget and Expense Management
resolvedSprint.goal: Extend shared-budget permissions, reconcile expense splits and manual settlements, and support durable expense drafts with safe synchronization. Implementation order: FP-59 → FP-60 → FP-61. Estimate and split oversized increments before starting.

futureSprints.name: Wiki and Shopping Integration
futureSprints.goal: Improve discovery of reviewed local-language product and recipe knowledge, then turn recipes into market-aware shopping lists with explicit purchase-to-expense conversion. Implementation order: FP-62 → FP-63.

futureSprints.name: Seller and Messaging
futureSprints.goal: Enable an approved seller profile and offer pilot, followed by private buyer-to-seller text conversations with ownership and participant access controls. Implementation order: FP-57 → FP-58.
